description: A point and digits after an exponent make an invalid number literal
notes: By the grammar, 1e5.5 is the literal 1e5 followed by the legacy index operator .5, which parses and only fails when evaluated. The reference scanner's NumberLit rule in hclsyntax/scan_tokens.rl reads 1e5.5 as one token, and numberLitValue in parser.go then rejects it.
